About the Masjid

✦

A house of Allah for our community

Sayazar Masjid serves the people of Abbottabad with the five daily prayers, Jumu'ah, and a place for learning, remembrance and brotherhood. All are welcome to pray, to learn the Qur'an, and to take part in the life of the masjid.

مسجد سایہ زار ایبٹ آباد کے اہلِ علاقہ کے لیے پانچ وقت کی نماز، جمعہ، قرآن کی تعلیم اور ذکر و اذکار کا مرکز ہے۔ آپ سب کو خوش آمدید۔

  • Five daily prayers in congregation
  • Jumu'ah khutbah & prayer
  • Nazra & Hifz Qur'an classes for children
  • Taraweeh in Ramadan
  • Nikah services
  • Janazah arrangements
